_comment: Central inventory of every primary write action in the standalone Breakfast Admin. Each entry maps a UI action to its real backend path. `bin/console admin:action-check` fails CI if any production action is not fully implemented, if its API resource isn't routed, if a mutation lacks a permission, or if its persistence service/method is missing. Keeping this in sync is how we prevent shipping a button with no working backend.

actions.label: Move portfolio record through its workflow
